comparison.clock_conclusion: The observed clock condition was comparable: loaded samples were 1350 MHz in both Watcher-enabled and recorded Watcher-disabled traces.
comparison.watcher_conclusion: The previous 2.1945/25.0023 TFLOPS catalogue did run with Watcher attached. The committed 2026-10-02 9.113/44.759 TFLOPS fidelity record declares watcher=false, but it uses L1 inputs and a different catalogue path, so it is not a clean Watcher-only experiment.
comparison.causal_conclusion: Watcher overhead remains a plausible condition difference but is not established as causal because no same-run no-Watcher remeasurement of stock plus current one-tile rows was completed before the required post-abnormal-exit stop.

operational_notes: No connection alias, host identity, or shell-only connection name is part of this record.
The requested no-Watcher stock/current-one-tile remeasurement was not run after the batch-4 diagnostic's later abnormal temporary-debug exit and recovery protocol.
Throughput rows are numerical-correctness-gated; the two-tile rows were not throughput candidates.
